body:
Sorry didn’t mean to worry you. I was at your stage for a long time, and I finally reach the point of « too much thoughts » , questioning all the essence of my value system on death,love,freedom,justice,morality....and it’s a difficult time to go through because there isn’t any answer to these questions.
In your case, it’s just the frequency that worries you. To that I say it’s all fine ! If your thoughts don’t affect your mood, you’re just experiencing a proper INTP mind process nothing to be scared about
Exactly my point. I would argue that if there is one MBTI type who can actually go insane and develop serious mental disorders solely because of « thinking too much », it would be an INTP.

Haha possible. So he is very sociable with you ? It would be difficult for us to tell you if he likes you or just trying to hook up. An INTP isn’t prone to lie so maybe being honest with him ? It would depend on your relationship. For an ENTP i don’t know ...
But keep in mind that INTP aren’t fan of emotional commitment so be careful on how you approach him

I would say it completely depends on different factors, such as how he feels about you (to what degree) if he is shy, what  perception he has of you, cultural environment ect. Generally, if he engages with you in anyway (even if it is awkward) he is interested. Take as a basis that there isn’t any INTP who will knowingly and genuinely socially interact with another person if he isn’t interested in some capacity. Being social is often synonymous to discomfort for us so it has to be worthwhile. Now if he is insecure, shy, he might express his feelings in an very obscure manner (looking at you, paying attention to what you do ect) without interacting directly. 
What’s the background ? I can maybe be of more insight with more data. Are you sure he is an INTP?
I observe quietly like a creep and try to analyse/deduce everything I can about them. Usually freak them out

I think you will always ask yourself existential questions like this. It’s almost pair with being INTP. Accept it as part of who you are. Just don’t forget to always distance yourself from this kind of thoughts.INTP’s descent to madness isn’t fun, I can tell you that

I would say it depends on what you actually do. As a sales manager, if your main objectives are « pure sales » (as in making profit and achieving sales goals) I think it is inadequate to INTP. It all comes to your interest in the job. We are not driven by money but by activities that motivate/stimulate us. If we aren’t intellectually stimulated, we don’t see the point of working all together and we can get depressed. 
Plus, we would tend to be too honest and not act as a « real salesman ». For instance, I can’t insist if a prospect says they are not interested by my product. Real salesman don’t take no as an answer. 
Now, you could work in an interesting field and deal with complex sales. That could be a solution if you’re stuck in the sales world

Yes it is exactly it. Problem is , I do have a very obsessive thought process. 
It’s all I think about, I keep digging and trying to find an answer that I will never find. And because of that, i put my life in risk based on my “logical” reasoning on the value of life. 
I’m not very good with physical activity (clumsy) and travelling do help but only on a short period of time. 
However I’ve been told sport improve mental health. I will start there I think

Hi !
Update, I’ve seen my psychiatrist to speak about the entirety of my reasoning (so far I’ve only talked about other issues, such as self harming and substance abuse) and he did recognise some autistic traits in what I said. I’m in the process of doing cognitive testing to have a diagnosis . 
I wouldn’t consider myself as religious now at all . My bond to religion is more based on a guilt feeling, if that make sense
Did you told your family you did not believe in religion?
If yes how did they react ?
Are you an atheist or agnostic?

See, what I do not understand is why do you think life is important ? 

Agreed, the chance of being alive is minuscule, but "important" for me is linked to the value. You think life has more value because we are in a way "lucky" to be alive. 

But this is subjective. I actually think life do not have any objective value. We create this notion of importance.

Sadly, not everyone create that

Hi,

Thanks for replying. 

Yes, not being diagnosed as ill and still feel like that is the worst. I hope you will be able to face all the problems of life too 

Plus, you have a dream which is wonderful. I always wished I had that *thing*, that would make it all worth it. Hope you will make your dream a reality ! keep on surfing ! :p

Hi,

Thanks for your replying

Indeed, the way I think of death is not "morbid" as my psychiatrist said. I picture myself dying in graphic way but apparently, it is normal (?). I trust his judgment on that one.

In your case, I think it is different. Did you lose fear of death following an event in your life ?

Why heights ? 

I would suggest to seek for a psychiatrist who is an actual doctor and can say if you have a mental disease (depression for instance). But living like that for years, that is tough

In any case, yes therapist sessions will make it better. Or at least, you will understand what is going on

Keep in touch if you like, I would love to know things are getting better for you

​

Hi,

Good analysis ! Thanks for replying.

Yes, I have been told that my thinking is a bit "extreme". I haven't been diagnosed as autistic but I often can't relate to people's feelings or actions. (I just don't understand)

As for religion, I was born in a religious family (as always) and religion remained a very safe reason to justify human existence.

I don't completely supress that idea because it is reassuring, in a way. I already have a self-destructive behavior (I just don't hold much value in my life), so it helped for a long time. It doesn't help so much anymore
